Chapter 1 verified requests第一章已核对任务

HIDDEN

Varenne Lighthouse

Opens during the Ruan regional route and must be done before the orphanage story advances. Reward: 2 (+1) BP. Ask whether anything else needs attention to earn the bonus.卢安地区路线中开放，必须在孤儿院剧情推进前完成。奖励 2（+1）BP；结束前询问是否还有其他工作可获得额外 BP。

BOARD

Sapphirl Snapshot

Reward: 2 (+2) BP. Take the full tower photo from the correct position for the maximum bonus; complete it before leaving the Ruan route.奖励 2（+2）BP。站在正确位置拍下完整高塔可拿满额外 BP；离开卢安路线前完成。

Human Intervention人为干预

A remake-added Ruan request from Portos. Reward: 2 (+1) BP. Clear it before departing for Jenis Academy.由波尔图斯触发的卢安重制版新增任务。奖励 2（+1）BP；前往杰尼丝学院前完成。
